description: Conformance cases for the connector version rules in connector_checks.py. Each case is one connector folder, connectors/<name>/: base is its copy on the base branch, which stands for the published version, and files is the pull request's copy. base: null means the pull request adds the connector, and files: null means it removes the folder. expect is this check's result: pass means no errors (warnings are allowed), fail means at least one error, and error is a fragment of this repository's own message. A file is given as UTF-8 text or as base64 bytes. The catalog publisher applies the same rules when it publishes a connector, so another tool that checks these folders should give the same result on the cases for the rules it implements. The fixtures are not complete connectors: their connector.yaml lacks fields the schema requires, and a case holds no other file unless its rule is about one. validate_skills.py runs every case before it checks anything, and tests/test_connector_checks.py runs them too.
